label: Positive observer-cell weights realize every interior conditional likelihood
paraphrase: Unit weights on the two observer cells of an existing three-cell sampling row recover its observer-conditioned likelihood; when the other-observer cell has positive mass, suitable positive weights give every strictly interior rational likelihood.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: An independently warranted observer-weighting or record-yield rule that fixes the observer-conditioned likelihood used in the fine-tuning comparison, then the existing designer inference and identification with GOD_4.
connection_plan.blocker: The control shows only that unconstrained positive weights do not fix the likelihood; it does not show that any admissible weighting rule is unavailable.
